title: Non Overlapping Intervals
summary: Delete as few intervals as possible so that the remaining intervals do not overlap.
statement: Delete as few intervals as possible so that the remaining intervals do not overlap. An interval ending exactly where another begins is compatible.

examples.explanation: Remove the long interval to keep both short ones.
Keep one of the identical intervals.

hints: Conceptual: Keeping the most intervals is equivalent to removing the fewest.
Directional: Finishing sooner leaves more time for later choices.
Implementation: Sort by end. Keep each interval whose start is at least the end of the last kept interval.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space when sorting a copy.
